title: RTPproxy: Remove the codec-mapping and transcode parameters
description:
The 'm' / 'M' "codec Mapping" and 't' / 'T' "Transcode to" command
parameters were proprietary extensions (erlrtpproxy, now end-of-life).

Upstream rtpproxy has never supported transcoding: its command-modifier
parser accepts a fixed set of options and rejects anything else as an
unknown modifier, so neither 'm' nor 't' can appear in real traffic. The
codec-mapping parameter was, on top of that, never actually decoded here -
its case only skipped the value behind a /* TODO */.

Drop both entirely: their value_string entries, the header fields and
subtrees, the parameter cases, and the stale "setup codec mapping" FIXME
on the RTP conversation setup. The other unofficial extensions (DTMF,
accoUnting) are left in place.
